info.comment: Flat vector food product: council yogurt. A short white yogurt cup with a blue foil lid slightly peeled, a gray spoon beside it. Corporate office aesthetic, clean geometric lines, limited palette navy #1B3A6B, bright blue #2F6FED, cool gray, white. No text, no letters, no faces, no photorealism, no gradients, no 3D, no neon, centered, crisp edges.
